column1: # Every monitored input, in index order (the index is the transition-ring id). Generated into C by scripts/gen_awto_inputs.py.
# kind: bit | analog (8-bit, deadband) | byte (8-bit register)
# src: p1/p3 (MCU port bit a) | p30 (P3.0, active low) | adc0/adc1/adc2 | vsync/vcmp (VGA scaler regs 0x4E/0xCD) | xreg (XDATA reg a, mask b) | key0/key1 (band a..b of adc0/adc1)
# DPS15/16/17 (DP connector AUX sense) are not logged: DPS17 pulses ~4 ms every 60-100 ms and would flood the 32-entry ring.
# text: VALUE column label on the screen. screen: y = a row of the diagnostic console (rows come first, in order). log: y = changes go to the I2C ring.
